detailed_description: The TOTP Generator creates a current one-time code from a Base32-style secret in the browser. You can paste a secret, generate a random secret, copy the secret, view the current code, see a 30-second countdown, and copy the code when available. The secret input is uppercased and limited to Base32 characters, and codes are generated through the local helper used by the component. The tool does not scan QR codes, choose time steps or HMAC algorithms, configure digit length, show raw counters or HMAC values, enter custom timestamps, test historical tokens, detect clock drift, or verify codes against an authentication service.
usage_steps: Paste a Base32-style secret key into the Secret field.
Optionally click Generate to create a random secret.
Copy the secret if you need to save it elsewhere.
Review the current code and the 30-second countdown.
Copy the code when it is available.
usage_examples: Generate a current code from a known Base32-style secret for a quick local check.
Create a random secret to test a simple authenticator setup flow.
Copy a generated code into a temporary test form before it expires.
Watch the countdown to know when the displayed code will refresh.

faqs.question: How does TOTP authentication work?
faqs.answer: Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP, RFC 6238) calculate a 6-digit verification code using a shared Base32 secret key and the current Unix epoch timestamp divided into 30-second windows.

faqs.question: Is it safe to generate TOTP codes in this web tool?
faqs.answer: Yes. All HMAC-SHA1 computations and secret key generation run strictly within your local browser runtime. Secrets are never transmitted to or logged on any server.

faqs.question: Can I use this tool to recover accounts when my phone is unavailable?
faqs.answer: If you have your backup Base32 secret key safely stored, you can enter it here to instantly generate the current verification token.
